==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Visit the [[Pockmark crystal|Searing crystal]] near [[Serenity Temple]].
* Visit the [[Flame Temple]].
* Visit the [[Wizard's Tower]].
* Visit [[The Mausoleum (landmark)|the Mausoleum]] in [[Majesty's Rest]].
* Visit [[Anvil Rock (landmark)|Anvil Rock]].
* Visit [[the Falls (NPC)|the Falls]] in the [[Maguuma Jungle]].
* Visit the ancient [[temple of Lyssa]] in [[Mineral Springs]].
* Visit [[Lonely Vigil|the ruined statues]] of [[the Arid Sea]].
* See [[Festival Coordinator Teron]] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 2,005 [[Experience]]
* 2,012 [[Gold]]
* [[Proof of Flames]]

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
'''Festival Coordinator Teron'''
:''"The Wayfarer's Reverie is a celebration of adventure. As we have walked many roads and traveled many lands to reach this place, so do many more roads open before us.''

:''Why not get into the festive spirit, hero? Visit some of this land's storied locations and let the memories of days past strengthen your resolve."''
{{offer dialog
|accept = You know, I am in the mood for some sightseeing.
|decline = I was thinking of settling down, actually.
|ask = Visit each location at your own pace and take in the sights.
}}

===Reward dialogue===
;Festival Coordinator Teron
:''"I can see from the look on your face that your latest journey has been a success! The memories of your travels will go with you as you continue forward.

:''In addition, here's a token to remember this festival."''

== Notes ==
*Only one player [[character]] or [[hero]] in the [[party]] needs to arrive at the objective, which strongly encourages [[running]]. The runner does not need the quest to trigger the objective for other players.
*This quest has good synergy with the final objective of [[Wayfarer's Reverie: Elona]], going from the [[Crystal Overlook]] into [[the Arid Sea]].
*You do not get credit for the Mausoleum if you visit it during [[A Vengeance of Blades]]

== Trivia ==
* The rewards are a reference to the year ''[[Guild Wars Prophecies]]'' was released (2005) and the year ''[[Guild Wars 2]]'' was released (2012).
